remarks:
Charming Country Home in the Beautiful Western NY Countryside!

Enjoy the best of country living in this charming two-story, old-style home nestled in the beautiful Western New York countryside just outside the city! Offering plenty of outdoor space and a comfortable layout, this 3-bedroom, 1-bath home blends classic charm with several important updates.

The spacious eat-in kitchen features convenient bar seating, perfect for everyday meals and entertaining. The generously sized primary bedroom boasts a skylight, bringing in plenty of natural light. Additional highlights include first-floor laundry, an enclosed porch, and an enclosed front entryway with extra storage.

Recent improvements include a renovated bathroom (July 2026), a newly installed furnace (2025), and a new water filtration system (2025). The home also features newer windows, including a brand-new kitchen window, along with a roof approximately 13 years old and a garage roof replaced in 2023.

Step outside and enjoy the peaceful country setting, complete with an above-ground pool and plenty of room to relax, entertain, or enjoy the outdoors. The property also offers an attached garage, a pellet stove for added comfort, and appliances that are included with the sale.

The septic system has been pumped every 3–4 years, and the seller has county septic drawings available for added convenience.

If you’re looking for country charm, outdoor space, and valuable updates, this home is one you won’t want to miss!
